name: crypto-primitive-auditors
description: Domain auditors for cryptographic primitives: elliptic curves, pairings, BLS, hash functions, polynomial commitments, Merkle trees, Fiat-Shamir transcripts, encryption schemes, and classical signature schemes (ECDSA, Schnorr/BIP-340, Ed25519, RSA-PSS/PKCS#1 v1.5).
